description: This file defines the ProductRelationshipService interface, specifying methods for managing product relationships, groups, and related entities in an e-commerce system.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a product relationship, throws ServiceException on failure.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves product relationships by store, product, type, and optionally language.

methods.name: listByProduct
methods.description: Lists all relationships for a specific product.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product relationship groups for a store.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Creates a new product group within a store.

methods.name: getByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves relationships associated with a specific group within a store, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: deleteGroup
methods.description: Deletes a product group from a store.

methods.name: deactivateGroup
methods.description: Deactivates (disables) a product group within a store.

methods.name: activateGroup
methods.description: Activates (enables) a product group within a store.
